checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
tmp=Path("/tmp/miy-boundary-review-fixes-mhwkcu6y")
baseline=json.loads((tmp/"baseline.json").read_text())
old=(tmp/"docs/APP-BOUNDARIES.md").read_text()
app=Path("docs/APP-BOUNDARIES.md").read_text()
section=lambda s,n:s.split("## "+n+"\n",1)[1].split("\n## ",1)[0]
ids=lambda s:re.findall(r"^\| (BV-\d\d) \|",s,re.M)
assert ids(old)==ids(app) and len(ids(app))==14
assert section(old,"기존 검증의 승계")==section(app,"기존 검증의 승계")
for key in ("BV-13","BV-14"):
    row=lambda s:next(l for l in s.splitlines() if l.startswith("| "+key+" |"))
    assert row(old)==row(app)
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("links","scripts/check-doc-links.py")
links=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(links)
assert links.anchors(tmp/"docs/APP-BOUNDARIES.md",{}).issubset(links.anchors(Path("docs/APP-BOUNDARIES.md"),{}))
changed=[];preserved=0
for name,before in baseline.items():
    path=Path(name);after=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() if path.is_file() else None
    if before!=after:changed.append(name)
    if name.startswith(("docs/archive/","docs/releases/")):
        assert before==after,name
        preserved+=1
assert hashlib.sha256(Path("docs/VALIDATION.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==baseline["docs/VALIDATION.md"]
assert hashlib.sha256(Path("docs/IMPLEMENTATION-RESULTS.md").read_bytes()).hexdigest()==baseline["docs/IMPLEMENTATION-RESULTS.md"]
tracked=subprocess.run(["git","diff","--name-only"],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout.splitlines()
assert all(n.startswith("docs/") or n in ("README.md","AGENTS.md") for n in tracked)
for name in changed:
    if not name.endswith(".md"):continue
    fence=None
    for line in Path(name).read_text().splitlines():
        match=re.match(r"^\s*(`{3,}|~{3,})",line)
        if not match:continue
        marker=match.group(1)
        if fence is None:fence=marker
        elif marker[0]==fence[0] and len(marker)>=len(fence):fence=None
    assert fence is None,name
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS","stableAcceptanceIds":14,"inheritedRequirementRows":11,"independentAcceptanceRowsUnchanged":["BV-13","BV-14"],"protectedArchiveAndEvidenceFiles":preserved,"legacyAnchorsAndResultHistoryPreserved":True,"changedDocsThisTask":changed},ensure_ascii=False))

PY
